resources.string: Life\'s big projects, one step at a time
Moving, renovating, a baby on the way, an estate to settle. Imorn knows the usual steps, puts a date on each of them and shows you only what matters today.
Every chapter starts from what usually needs doing, grouped the way it happens, with a link to the source wherever a rule applies.
Never more than three things a day
The rest waits its turn. Putting something off until tomorrow is a choice, not a failure.
Set the moving day and every step gets its day, and the last day when one really counts.
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your papers and photos never leave the device.
Pick as many as you like. It only decides which templates come first; all of them are always there.
First flat, studies, first job, driving licence
Buying a home, moving in together, children, renovating
A bigger home, children moving out, helping a parent
Retiring, moving somewhere smaller, a will
Someone has died, a separation, a lost job
